mines.mine_notes: Polymetallic VMS deposit, Ambler Mining District, NW Alaska; held by Ambler Metals LLC (50/50 JV with South32). 50%-attributable figures shown. S-K 1300 TRS (Ausenco/Wood/SRK, Nov 2022): open pit, 13-yr mine life, initial capital $1,177M (total $1,719M), prices $3.46/lb Cu, $1,615/oz Au, $21.17/oz Ag; Pb 0.56%, Zn 2.90%. Oct 6, 2025: binding LOI with U.S. Dept of War for conditional strategic investment in domestic critical minerals. Permitting advancing; Dalton utility corridor land transfer to State of Alaska. No production; FY2025 comprehensive loss $42.2M (incl. $22.6M derivative loss). 2026 fully-funded exploration/development/permitting program. Note: 10-K states attributable figures on a 50% basis.
mines.processing: Planned: crushing/grinding, sequential flotation (Cu, Pb, Zn concentrates)

mines.mine_notes: Carbonate-hosted copper deposit, Ambler Mining District, NW Alaska; exploration stage; held by Ambler Metals LLC (50/50 JV). 50%-attributable resource 104.45 Mt @ 1.42% Cu (3,263.5 Mlb Cu attributable). S-K 1300 Initial Assessment (PEA, Nov 2024): 6,000 tpd underground, 17-yr mine life, 1.9 Blb Cu mined, pre-tax NPV8% $552M (IRR 23.6%), after-tax NPV8% $394M (IRR 20.0%); assumes re-purposing Arctic infrastructure. No reserves.

notes: Fiscal year ends November 30 (FY2025 = year ended Nov 30, 2025; 10-K reported Feb 17, 2026). Trilogy Metals Inc., formerly NovaCopper Inc. (BC corporation), dual-listed NYSE American and TSX (TMQ). Principal business: 50% interest in Ambler Metals LLC with South32; Upper Kobuk Mineral Projects (Arctic + Bornite) in NW Alaska. All 10-K reserve/resource figures quoted on 50%-attributable basis unless noted. Copper byproduct quantities computed from reported tonnes x grade; gold/silver reserves only at Arctic.
